# Phase 14 – AI Stack Governance & Execution Doctrine

Brand: **Digital Transition Marketing**
AI Orchestration System: **Neon Vision**
Status: **Control Architecture / Final Lock Layer**
Time Horizon: **2026+**

---

## Purpose of Phase 14

Phase 14 defines **how the entire AI stack is governed, locked, replaced, escalated, and evolved** without breaking services, SLAs, or revenue.

This phase ensures:
• No single tool failure can collapse operations
• No vendor lock-in can hold the agency hostage
• No AI model drift silently degrades performance
• Neon Vision operates as a **control plane**, not a chatbot

---

## 1. Neon Vision Control Plane (Authoritative Layer)

Neon Vision is **not a model** — it is an orchestration authority.

### Neon Vision Responsibilities

• Tool selection & routing
• Model arbitration (who answers, who executes)
• Data ingestion & normalization
• Performance monitoring & escalation
• Safety, compliance, and kill-switch logic
